about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300 PHEV engines for every Range Rover Sport P460e on the road.

codes.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport P460e ENGINE

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover Sport P460e from 2023 to present. The AJ300 PHEV features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ300 PHEV V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ300 PHEV rebuild.

compatibility.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport P460e ENGINE
compatibility.intro: The P460e uses the AJ300 PHEV powertrain — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine paired with an electric motor and battery pack. Because the PHEV system integrates engine and electric drivetrain components, compatibility is specific to the L461 chassis generation. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine and PHEV specification via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Range Rover Sport quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
